findings.title: Queries are interpolated twice in the shard-splitting path
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now interpolates every target via datasource.applyTemplateVariables() before delegating to splitQueriesByStreamShard(), which in turn calls runSplitQuery() (shardQuerySplitting.ts:163), and runSplitQuery() now also applies datasource.applyTemplateVariables() to the same targets (querySplitting.ts:299). The updated test even encodes this: a single target results in applyTemplateVariables being called 5 times (once in runShardSplitQuery plus once per shard group's runSplitQuery call). This is harmless only if applyTemplateVariables is fully idempotent; any non-idempotent interpolation (e.g. appending ad-hoc filter matchers via the request.filters argument, or transformations that are not replace-if-present) would be applied repeatedly, producing incorrect expressions sent to Loki. It also does redundant work per shard group. The shard path should either skip re-interpolation when calling runSplitQuery (e.g. an option) or interpolate only once.
